h1: Land Rover Trade & Fleet Engine Services
lede: Professional engine rebuild, replacement and reconditioning for commercial customers, fleets and B2B partners.

sections.heading: What Our Trade & Fleet Engine Services Include

blocks.html: Our trade and fleet engine services are designed for commercial customers who require professional engine rebuild, replacement or reconditioning for multiple vehicles. We work with independent repair workshops, automotive parts dealers, fleet operators and contract organisations across the UK.

items: **Engine Rebuild & Reconditioning** — Full strip-down, machining and reassembly of Land Rover engines to factory or better-than-factory tolerances, using Land Rover-specific tooling and OEM-quality parts.
**Engine Replacement & Supply & Fit** — Complete removal and replacement of engines for trade customers, with nationwide recovery available to bring vehicles to our workshop.
**Volume & Contract Work** — Tailored services for fleet operators with multiple vehicles, including ongoing maintenance programmes and priority scheduling to minimise downtime.
**B2B Reconditioning Solutions** — Specialised reconditioning of Land Rover, Range Rover and Jaguar engines for independent workshops and parts dealers.
**Defence & Government Contracts** — Contract work for UK MOD and other government organisations, including repair of Land Rover engines and associated assemblies.

blocks.html: Every trade engine service is backed by our [12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty](/warranty) on rebuild work, with genuine quality assurance processes throughout.

sections.heading: Our Trade & Fleet Engine Service Process

steps.title: Enquiry & Quotation
steps.body: Trade customers submit vehicle details and requirements. We provide a fixed-price quote based on your specific scope of work, with volume discounts available for fleet operators.

steps.title: Vehicle Recovery
steps.body: Nationwide recovery arranged from £70. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking and delivered directly to our workshop in Billericay, Essex.

steps.title: Full Inspection & Teardown
steps.body: Complete engine strip-down with full inspection of all components. We identify the extent of wear or damage and confirm the final scope of work before proceeding.

steps.title: Machining & Reconditioning
steps.body: On-site machining including cylinder boring, honing, crankshaft grinding and cylinder head reconditioning. All work follows BS AU257:2002 standards.

steps.title: Rebuild & Assembly
steps.body: Engine rebuilt using OEM-quality or genuine parts, with Land Rover-specific tooling and diagnostic equipment. Every component is inspected and measured during assembly.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Control
steps.body: Full testing including compression test, leak-down test and on-engine diagnostics. Every rebuild is road-tested before sign-off to confirm performance and reliability.

steps.title: Delivery & Warranty
steps.body: Vehicle returned to the customer with a full 12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty on rebuild work. Ongoing support available for fleet maintenance programmes.

sections.heading: Why Choose Land Rover Garage for Trade & Fleet

items: **Land Rover Specialists Since 2009** — We work exclusively on Land Rover and Range Rover engines. Our team has deep expertise across every model from classic Defenders to the latest L663 and L460 platforms.

**On-Site Machine Shop** — Cylinder boring, honing, crankshaft grinding and cylinder head reconditioning all performed in-house, not outsourced. This means faster turnaround and complete quality control.
**OEM-Quality Parts & Tooling** — We use genuine or OEM-quality parts throughout, with Land Rover-specific diagnostic equipment and tooling for every engine family.
**Nationwide Recovery** — Most vehicles recovered within hours of booking. We bring your vehicle to our workshop so you don't have to arrange transport separately.
**12-Month Unlimited-Mileage Warranty** — Every trade rebuild comes with a comprehensive warranty that gives your customers confidence in our work.
**BS AU257:2002 Standards** — All remanufacturing follows British Standard BS AU257:2002, with documented quality assurance processes at every stage.

**Defence & Government Contract Experience** — Our workshop has undertaken contract work for UK MOD and other government organisations, with the documentation and traceability that defence contracts require.

blocks.html: Explore our full range of professional Land Rover engine services for commercial customers.

items.q: What trade and fleet engine services do you offer?
items.a: We offer comprehensive engine rebuild, replacement and reconditioning services for commercial customers, including independent workshops, automotive parts dealers, fleet operators and contract organisations. Our services cover the full Land Rover range including Defender, Discovery, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Velar and Evoque.

items.q: Do you offer engine services for fleet operators with multiple vehicles?
items.a: Yes. We provide tailored engine services for fleet operators, including ongoing maintenance programmes, volume rebuilds and replacement services designed to minimise vehicle downtime. Fleet operators benefit from priority scheduling and dedicated account management.

items.q: What quality standards do you follow for trade engine services?
items.a: All our trade engine services follow industry-standard remanufacturing processes and BS AU257:2002 (British Standard) for remanufactured engines. We use Land Rover-specific tooling and diagnostic equipment, with genuine or OEM-quality parts used throughout.

items.q: Do you work on defence and government contracts?
items.a: Yes. Our workshop undertakes contract work for defence and government organisations, including UK MOD contracts for repair of Land Rover engines and associated assemblies, particularly for Defender and other military-spec vehicles.

items.q: Do you offer engine recovery services for trade customers?
items.a: Yes. We offer nationwide engine recovery services for trade customers, with most vehicles recovered within a few hours of booking. Recovery is a separate charge starting from £70 and can be arranged as part of your engine service package.

items.q: What is the typical turnaround time for a trade engine rebuild?
items.a: Most engine rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from arrival at our workshop, subject to parts availability and the specific scope of work required. Trade customers benefit from priority scheduling to minimise vehicle downtime.
